lines.en: label sportswars14:
scene mayachasing1
: Hey! Asshole! When I said I had legs, I didn’t mean it was okay for you to make me wear them down until there’s nothing left!
lines.zh: : 喂！混蛋！我说我有腿，可不是让你把它们磨到什么都不剩！

lines.en: : Just how long are you planning on keeping this up for?! How many more miles do we need to walk until you realize how much of a coward you’re being right now?!
lines.zh: : 你打算就这么走多久？！还要再走多少英里，你才能意识到自己现在有多像个懦夫？！

lines.en: : You can turn around and leave whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你随时可以转身走人。

lines.en: : And give you the satisfaction of escaping me and thinking that {i}this{/i} is something you can run from too?! Fuck that! This is a problem {i}you{/i} created! And I’m {i}still{/i} polite enough to try and fix it!
lines.zh: : 然后让你得意地从我身边逃走，还以为{i}这{/i}也是你能躲得掉的事？！去你的！这是{i}你自己{/i}造出来的问题！我{i}还算{/i}客气，才想着帮你解决！

lines.en: : Go home.
lines.zh: : 回家去。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}have{/i} a home!
lines.zh: : 我没{i}有{/i}家！

lines.en: : You have the dorm, don’t you? And with Ami gone, you’ve got the room all to yourself. I’d be excited if I were you.
lines.zh: : 你不是有宿舍吗？而且 Ami 不在了，整个房间都是你一个人的。换作是我，我可高兴了。

lines.en: scene mayachasing2
: Oh, yeah! Nothing says “exciting” like spending months and months alone in a room and waiting for someone to come visit! That always works out great for me! Just, here’s the thing-
lines.zh: : 哦，对啊！还有什么比一个人在房间里待上好几个月、等着有人来看你更“刺激”的呢！这招对我一向很管用！只是，问题是——

lines.en: scene mayachasing1
: No one fucking visits me anymore!
lines.zh: : 现在他妈的没人来看我了！

lines.en: : Well...no one except Ayane. But I’m starting to think the actual Ayane was abducted by aliens and replaced with a well-made clone who is now attempting to probe me for information. And not in the good way either!
lines.zh: : 嗯……除了 Ayane。不过我开始觉得，真正的 Ayane 已经被外星人绑架，换成了一个制作精良的克隆体，现在正试图从我这里套取情报。而且还不是那种好的方式！

lines.en: scene mayachasing3
: Just tell me what you want, please. What can I do to make you leave me alone?
lines.zh: : 你就告诉我你到底想要什么吧，求你了。我要怎么做你才肯放过我？

lines.en: : I’ve been telling you what I want since the moment I had to slap your sorry ass out of another blackout at the shrine! I want an {i}explanation!{/i}
lines.zh: : 从我在神社把你那可怜的屁股抽醒、让你从又一次昏厥里醒过来那一刻起，我就一直在告诉你我想要什么！我要一个{i}解释{/i}！

lines.en: : You don’t do this to me! I’m the exception! {i}I’m{/i} the one who’s special to you! But now there’s all this shit with Noriko and- since when the {i}fuck{/i} are you talking to Niki again?! Is {i}that{/i} what this is about?!
lines.zh: : 你不能这么对我！我是例外！{i}我{/i}才是对你而言特别的那个人！可现在又冒出 Noriko 那堆破事，还有——你{i}他妈{/i}从什么时候又开始跟 Niki 说话了？！就是因为{i}这事{/i}吗？！

lines.en: : Are you trying to disappear on {i}me{/i} now?! After all I’ve done for you?! After all we’ve done {i}together?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你现在是想在{i}我{/i}面前人间蒸发吗？！在我为你做了那么多之后？！在我们{i}一起{/i}经历了那么多之后？！

lines.en: : Is this a hobby of yours?! Making one girl fall for you just to scramble to a different one the second shit gets {i}too hard{/i}?! Did Ami remove your backbone while you were unconscious or something???
lines.zh: : 这是你的爱好吗？！先让一个女孩爱上你，然后一遇到{i}难处{/i}就手忙脚乱地换下一个？！Ami 是不是趁你昏迷的时候把你的脊梁骨给摘了？？？

lines.en: : If I tell you it’s because of Niki, will that be enough to make you leave?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你是为了 Niki，这样足够让你走了吗？

lines.en: scene mayachasing4
: Don’t even joke about that...
lines.zh: : 这种事连开玩笑都不行……

lines.en: : You {i}know{/i} how I feel about her. And we agreed that we wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 你{i}知道{/i}我对她是什么感觉。而且我们说好了不会——

lines.en: : See, that’s the problem. I’ve never {i}agreed{/i} to anything with you.
lines.zh: : 瞧，问题就在这儿。我从来没跟你{i}达成{/i}过任何约定。

lines.en: : Sensei. {i}Come on.{/i} You know that’s not true.
lines.zh: : Sensei。{i}别这样{/i}。你知道那不是真的。

lines.en: : Maybe not from your perspective. But from mine, it seems like {i}you’re{/i} the one who was abducted by aliens and replaced with a well-made clone.
lines.zh: : 也许在{i}你{/i}的角度不是。但在我看来，被外星人绑架、换成精良克隆体的人好像是你。

lines.en: : So well-made, in fact, that I can’t even look at you without being overcome by every single emotion known to man.
lines.zh: : 精良到我一看到你，就会被人类已知的所有情绪同时淹没。

lines.en: : With all due respect, I have a hard time believing you can feel more than a maximum of three emotions. Let alone all of them at once.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，我很难相信你能感受到超过三种情绪。更别说同时感受到全部了。

lines.en: : But given that those are the same three emotions {i}I{/i} am able to have, I can empathize with where you’re coming from and will not think less of you for how much you want to strangle, embrace, and fuck me right now.
lines.zh: : 不过既然那正好也是{i}我{/i}仅有的三种情绪，我能理解你的处境，也不会因为你现在多想掐死我、抱住我、操我而看轻你。

lines.en: : Go home.
lines.zh: : 回家去。

lines.en: : Take me to {i}yours.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那就带我去{i}你家{/i}。

lines.en: : I have no idea what all of this bullshit Clone-yane has got you on is, what with me “not being the same Maya” or whatever the fuck, but I {i}am.{/i} I am {i}me.{/i} Nothing has changed.
lines.zh: : 我不知道 Clone-yane 给你灌了什么迷魂汤，什么叫“我不是原来那个 Maya”之类的狗屁，但{i}我就是{/i}。我就是{i}我{/i}。什么都没变。

lines.en: : Everything has changed. But you’re the last person I want to talk to about it. And you need to understand that because just being around you is making this so much harder than it already is.
lines.zh: : 一切都变了。而我最不想谈这件事的人就是你。你得明白这一点，因为光是和你待在一起，就已经让这一切比原本更难熬了。

lines.en: scene mayachasing3

: Have you thought for a second that maybe it’s only hard in the first place because you {i}want{/i} it to be that way? It’s not like you’ve never intentionally torn your life to shreds before, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过，也许它之所以难，本来就只是因为你{i}想{/i}让它难？你又不是没故意把自己的生活撕成碎片过，Sensei。

lines.en: : But that’s why I exist. I’m here to pick up those pieces and put you back together so that you can do the same thing for me when {i}I{/i} decide to act all suicidal for months on end.
lines.zh: : 但那正是{i}我{/i}存在的意义。我在这儿把这些碎片捡起来，把你拼回原样，好等哪天我一连几个月犯起自杀的毛病时，你也能照样为我做同样的事。

lines.en: : That’s how the cycle works. That’s the system we’ve created.
lines.zh: : 循环就是这么运作的。这就是我们建立起来的体系。

lines.en: : You break, I fix. I break, you fix. Then, we fill the radio silence with sex and our shitty idea of what “affection” means until we’re too tired to keep our eyes open and fall asleep next to one another.
lines.zh: : 你碎了，我来补。我碎了，你来补。然后我们用性、用我们那套糟糕的“爱意”定义填满这段无线电静默，直到累得睁不开眼，在彼此身边睡去。

lines.en: : Only metaphorically though. Because Ami’s gotten way too close to finding us in bed before and, with this suddenly heightened suspicion of hers, I’m not about to take any chances on-
lines.zh: : 不过只是打个比方。因为 Ami 以前就差点撞见我们在床上，再加上她这突如其来的高度警觉，我可不想在这上面冒任何风险——

lines.en: scene mayachasing5
: What part of “leave” don’t you understand?!
lines.zh: : “走”这个字你到底有哪部分没听懂？！

lines.en: scene mayachasing6
: The “leave” part!
lines.zh: : 就是“走”那部分！

lines.en: : That’s the whole thing!
lines.zh: : 整件事就是那个字！

lines.en: : Yeah! And it’s a thing {i}I’ve{/i} never had to deal with before because you’ve always wanted me around! And now that you either don’t or are {i}pretending{/i} to not want me, I’m fucking confused!
lines.zh: : 对！而且是件{i}我{/i}从来没应付过的事，因为你以前一直都想让我待在身边！现在你不知是真不想还是{i}装作{/i}不想，我他妈糊涂了！

lines.en: : Well, I’d be confused too if I suddenly woke up in a world that was entirely different from what I was used to.
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是我一觉醒来发现自己身处一个跟习惯的完全不同的世界，我也会糊涂。

lines.en: scene mayachasing7
: Oh my god. This shit again? Really?
lines.zh: : 我的天。又来这套？真的假的？

lines.en: : That happened to me once, you know. Maybe more than once.
lines.zh: : 这种事在我身上发生过一次，你知道吗。也许不止一次。

lines.en: : But even with how confused and how lost I was navigating a brand new world, there was a light there- guiding me along. Pissing me off and annoying me every step of the way.
lines.zh: : 可即便我在一个全新的世界里迷茫得不知所措，那里还是有一道光——一路指引着我。一路上都在气我、烦我。

lines.en: : I feel like it would have been the other way around. But please, do proceed with your maniacal ramblings about alternate universes and whatever version of me you allegedly liked screwing the most.
lines.zh: : 我觉得应该是反过来才对。不过请继续，继续你那些关于平行宇宙、还有据称你最喜欢操的我的哪个版本的疯话。

lines.en: : The Maya {i}I{/i} know would never chase after me like this. She was far too jaded and far too busy worrying about other things. {i}Bigger{/i} things.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}认识的那个 Maya 绝不会像这样追着我跑。她太愤世嫉俗了，也太忙着操心别的事。{i}更大{/i}的事。

lines.en: scene mayachasing8
: She never gave a shit about how I felt or how I acted.
lines.zh: : 她从来不在乎我的感受，也不在乎我的行为。

lines.en: : Or, at least that’s how she seemed on the surface. I’m sure those things got to her internally if the way we felt at the end was at all indicative of her feelings on the way there.
lines.zh: : 至少表面上是这样。如果我们在最后的感觉能说明她在过程中的感受，那我相信那些事在她心里确实是有分量的。

lines.en: : But that was just the thing.
lines.zh: : 但问题恰恰就在这儿。

lines.en: : It was so hard to {i}figure out{/i} what she was feeling. And now you’re here wearing your heart on your sleeve and chasing after me when we both know I’m not worth it.
lines.zh: : 要{i}搞清楚{/i}她在想什么实在太难了。而现在你站在这里，把心全挂在袖子上追着我跑，可我们俩都心知肚明，我不值得。

lines.en: : Sensei, I’m only chasing after you because I’ve run out of options. And yeah, it’s a bit uncharacteristic, but I have a feeling you’d do the same for me if you ever had to.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我追着你，只是因为我已经没别的办法了。是啊，这不太像我，但我有种感觉，如果换成是我，你也会为我做同样的事。

lines.en: scene memories1
scene memories17
scene memories23
scene mayachasing3

: Besides, what does being {i}worth it{/i} even mean? We’re both all sorts of fucked up and, in the grand scheme of things, I can’t imagine anyone else ever finding us {i}worth{/i} it in the first place.
lines.zh: : 再说了，“{i}值得{/i}”到底是什么意思？我们俩都糟糕透顶，往大了说，我想不出还有谁会觉得我们{i}值得{/i}。

lines.en: : My Maya was a lot more conceited as well.
lines.zh: : 我的那个 Maya 可自负多了。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t get me wrong. I am a fucking {i}catch.{/i} But only on the outside.
lines.zh: : 哦，别误会。我他妈可是{i}抢手货{/i}。但只是表面上。

lines.en: scene mayachasing9
: In {i}here,{/i} I’m just as bad as you. I only give a shit about two people- and I’ve lied to one of them more times than I can even count.
lines.zh: : 在{i}这里面{/i}，我跟你一样糟糕。我只在乎两个人——而其中一个，我骗过的次数多得数不清。

lines.en: : I’m explosive. Sensitive. And, despite everything happening right now, I {i}hate{/i} confrontation. Hell, I’m probably even emotionally abusive at times.
lines.zh: : 我易燃易爆。敏感。而且，尽管现在闹成这样，我{i}讨厌{/i}正面冲突。该死，我大概有时候还会情绪虐待别人。

lines.en: : But you were the one who helped me understand that it’s {i}okay{/i} to be imperfect. That, so long as we can figure out a way to function out here, it doesn’t {i}matter{/i} who we really are.
lines.zh: : 可你才是那个让我明白“不完美也{i}没关系{/i}”的人。只要我们能想办法在外面活下去，我们到底是谁并不{i}重要{/i}。

lines.en: : Are you giving up on that? Are you so tired of camouflaging yourself that you’re fine with just holing up in your bedroom and letting Ami spoon-feed you until you die of old age and lack of exercise?
lines.zh: : 你要放弃这个了吗？你已经厌倦了伪装自己，宁愿窝在卧室里让 Ami 一勺一勺喂你，直到因为年老和缺乏运动而死？

lines.en: : It’s not that I’m {i}giving up.{/i} It’s that I’ve already lost everything that gave me a reason to go on in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不是我要{i}放弃{/i}。而是我已经失去了所有原本让我想继续下去的东西。

lines.en: : But you {i}haven’t!{/i} I’m right here! You just have to turn around and see me for who I am now rather than who I {i}was{/i} in whatever prolonged delusion apparently stripped me from your mind.
lines.zh: : 可你{i}没有{/i}！我就在这儿！你只要转过身，看看现在的我，而不是那个在某种漫长的妄想里被从你脑海里抹掉的我。

lines.en: : Oh, right. That’s another thing.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。还有一件事。

lines.en: : What’s another thing? What are you talking about now?
lines.zh: : 还有一件事是什么？你现在在说什么？

lines.en: : See, you probably don’t know this yet on account of you being Kumon-mi’s latest teenage newborn, but my memory’s been essentially erased.
lines.zh: : 你看，你大概还不知道——毕竟你是 Kumon-mi 最新出炉的少女新生儿——但我的记忆基本已经被抹掉了。

lines.en: : What? What’s that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 什么？这话什么意思？

lines.en: : It means that the only thing I really know about “our” past together is the fact that there was a past at all. And every other memory I made along the way is something you’ve yet to experience.
lines.zh: : 意思是，关于“我们”共同的过去，我唯一真正知道的，就是确实有过一段过去。而这一路上我留下的其他记忆，都是你还没经历过的。

lines.en: : Quit fucking with me, Sensei. Memories don’t just {i}disappear{/i} like that out of nowhere. And using that as an excuse to break things off is cowardly even for you.
lines.zh: : 别他妈耍我了，Sensei。记忆不会就这么凭空{i}消失{/i}。而且拿这个当分手的借口，连你也算得上懦夫。

lines.en: : This isn’t the world you’re familiar with, {i}Maya.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这不是你熟悉的那个世界，{i}Maya{/i}。

lines.en: : It might {i}seem{/i} like it is. But somewhere along the line, you got wrapped up in something terrible and confusing, then spat out back at the beginning as if it never happened at all.
lines.zh: : 也许{i}看起来{/i}是。但在某个节点上，你卷进了某件可怕又令人困惑的事，然后又被吐回了起点，仿佛什么都没发生过一样。

lines.en: : And I’m happy for you because it means you won’t have to suffer anymore. That’s where I come in.
lines.zh: : 我为你高兴，因为这意味着你再也不用受苦了。那就是我的用武之地。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta give kudos to you, though. Well, the {i}you{/i} that isn’t here anymore, I mean.
lines.zh: : 不过我得给{i}你{/i}点个赞。嗯，我是说那个已经不在这儿的那个你。

lines.en: : Because if experiencing this reunion {i}one time{/i} is enough to make me want to bite my tongue off, I can only imagine how it felt for her.
lines.zh: : 因为如果光是经历{i}一次{/i}这样的重逢就足以让我想把自己的舌头咬下来，我真想象不出她当时是什么感受。

lines.en: : Sensei...I’ve got {i}no{/i} fucking clue what all of this “something terrible” or “fake amnesia” shit is about, but if hearing you out will stop you from running, then fuck it. I’ll listen.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我他妈{i}完全{/i}不知道你说的“可怕的事”或“假装失忆”都是些什么鬼，但如果听你说完能让你不再跑，那去他的。我听着。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to have Ayane and, to a lesser extent, Makoto tormenting me about this on a weekly basis. But I trust you way more than I trust both of them.
lines.zh: : 被 Ayane 以及程度轻一些的 Makoto 每周为这事折磨是一回事。但我对你的信任，远比对他们俩的加起来还多。

lines.en: scene mayachasing3

: But I also want you to know that I’m not just going to go along with any of this because, even if you {i}are{/i} being sincere and your perception of the lives we’ve lived has been somehow mutilated, it’s not {i}real.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但我也想让你知道，我不会就这么全盘接受，因为即便你{i}是{/i}认真的、即便你对我们共同生活的认知被某种方式扭曲了，那也不是{i}真的{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} am Maya Makinami. {i}I{/i} am the best and worst secret you have ever kept. And {i}I{/i} am the type of girl who will chase you down if I have to because not even a million time-loops could stop me from doing that.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}是 Maya Makinami。{i}我{/i}是你保守过的最好也最坏的秘密。而{i}我{/i}是那种必要时一定会追到你为止的女孩，因为哪怕一百万次时间循环也拦不住我。

lines.en: : How many would it take then?
lines.zh: : 那要多少次才拦得住？

lines.en: : A million and one. I have to set a limit somewhere, you know.
lines.zh: : 一百万零一次。我总得给自己定个限度吧，你知道的。

lines.en: scene mayachasing10

: And hey, if this amnesia nonsense has any speck of truth to it at all, it’ll give you the pleasure of getting acquainted with me all over again. Which I’m sure would end up the same way it did last time.
lines.zh: : 而且嘿，如果这失忆的胡话里有一丁点真话，那你就有幸重新认识我一遍了。我敢肯定，结果会和上次一模一样。

lines.en: : You and I just...{i}work.{/i} Way better than we were ever supposed to. Which is precisely {i}why{/i} I can do things like chase you across town like this is some scene out of a movie.
lines.zh: : 你和我就是……{i}合拍{/i}。比我们本该有的程度合拍得多。{i}正因如此{/i}，我才能做出像追着你穿过整个镇子这种事，仿佛这是电影里的某个场景。

lines.en: : The bad news is that I am {i}very much{/i} no longer a virgin, so your {i}reacquaintment{/i} will not include the pleasure of deflowering me unless I really {i}am{/i} a clone and my hymen has regenerated.
lines.zh: : 坏消息是，我{i}早已经{/i}不是处女了，所以你{i}重新认识{/i}我的过程里不会有夺走我初夜的乐趣——除非我真{i}是{/i}克隆人，而且我的处女膜重新长出来了。

lines.en: : Which I hope it hasn’t because, as if I’m not too small for your massive penis now, {i}boy{/i} were things tough back in the study room.
lines.zh: : 我希望它没有，因为我现在本来就嫌自己太小配不上你那根巨物，更别说当年在自习室里{i}有多艰难{/i}了。

lines.en: : Go home, {i}Maya.{/i} I don’t want to do this with you.
lines.zh: : 回家去，{i}Maya{/i}。我不想跟你做这些。

lines.en: scene mayachasing11
: What if I break out my ultimate bargaining chip and go get my shrine maiden dress?
lines.zh: : 那要是我亮出终极筹码，去把我的巫女服拿来呢？

lines.en: : I don’t want to do {i}anything{/i} with you.
lines.zh: : 我不想跟你做{i}任何事{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t want to see you. I don’t want to talk to you. I don’t want to hear your voice. I don’t want to smell your perfume. I don’t want to see your shadow beside mine. And I {i}definitely{/i} don’t want to sleep with you.
lines.zh: : 我不想见你。我不想跟你说话。我不想听到你的声音。我不想闻到你的香水味。我不想看到你的影子挨着我的影子。而且我{i}绝对{/i}不想和你上床。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you’re still looking away. And you know that, the second you turn around, all of that will change since you’ll realize that {i}I’m still me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为你还一直别过头去。而你知道，只要你一转过身，这一切都会改变，因为你会意识到{i}我还是我{/i}。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure make-believe Maya would side with {i}me{/i} here since she’s the only person around who could ever properly comprehend how attractive and awesome I am.
lines.zh: : 而且我很确定，那个假想的 Maya 会站在{i}我{/i}这边，因为她是这世上唯一能真正理解我有多迷人、多棒的人。

lines.en: : If you want me to go home, take me there yourself...
lines.zh: : 如果你想让我回家，就亲自带我回去……

lines.en: : Then grab my shoulders, look me in the eyes, and decide what it {i}really{/i} is you want.
lines.zh: : 然后抓住我的肩膀，看着我的眼睛，决定你{i}真正{/i}想要的是什么。

lines.en: : Because I know you better than you do, Sensei. Even {i}if{/i} you’ve changed in the time we’ve spent apart.
lines.zh: : 因为我比你更了解你自己，Sensei。{i}即使{/i}在我们分开的这段时间里你变了。

lines.en: : I know how to make the pain go away.
lines.zh: : 我知道怎么让疼痛消失。

lines.en: : I know how to remind you of who you really are beneath all of the madness.
lines.zh: : 我知道怎么提醒你，在所有疯狂之下，你到底是谁。

lines.en: : But most importantly-
lines.zh: : 但最重要的是——

lines.en: : I know that today is a safe day and I’m sure I don’t need to explain to you why that is a thing you should be excited about.
lines.zh: : 我知道今天是安全日，而且我相信不需要我解释，你也明白为什么这是件该让你兴奋的事。

lines.en: scene mayachasing3
: Did that convince you? Can we finally stop walking now?
lines.zh: : 这说服你了吗？我们终于可以不用再走了吗？

lines.en: There’s a voice in the back of my head.
lines.zh: 我脑海深处有个声音。

lines.en: It’s quiet right now....but I can still feel it lingering.
lines.zh: 它现在很安静……但我仍能感觉到它在徘徊。

lines.en: I understand what it wants me to do.
lines.zh: 我明白它想要我做什么。

lines.en: But I don’t understand what {i}I{/i} want to do.
lines.zh: 但我不明白{i}我自己{/i}想做什么。

lines.en: Maybe this meat puppet won’t be that bad?
lines.zh: 也许这具肉身玩偶也没那么糟？

lines.en: It has the same packaging as my former love, at least.
lines.zh: 至少它的包装和我从前的爱人一模一样。

lines.en: It’s likely tender...{i}fresh.{/i}
lines.zh: 它大概很柔嫩……很{i}新鲜{/i}。

lines.en: Delectable in ways I only briefly got to experience before the world was ripped away again.
lines.zh: 它的美味，我在世界再次被撕裂之前只短暂地尝过。

lines.en: Besides...
lines.zh: 况且……

lines.en: It’s what {i}she{/i} would want, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 这也是{i}她{/i}想要的，不是吗？

lines.en: She had {i}me{/i} while {i}I{/i} was gone.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}不在的那段时间里，她拥有过{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: But I bet she waited longer.
lines.zh: 但我敢打赌，她等得更久。

lines.en: I bet she struggled just as hard at first.
lines.zh: 我敢打赌，她一开始也同样挣扎得厉害。

lines.en: But I bet she waited longer.
lines.zh: 但我敢打赌，她等得更久。

lines.en: scene black
: No...we’ve got plenty more walking to do.
lines.zh: : 不……我们还有很多路要走。

lines.en: : I’m taking you home.
lines.zh: : 我带你回家。

lines.en: : But your house is only a few blocks from-
lines.zh: : 可你家离这儿只有几个街区——

lines.en: : I’m taking you to a different one.
lines.zh: : 我要带你去的是另一个家。

lines.en: I bet she waited longer.
lines.zh: 我敢打赌，她等得更久。

lines.en: But hey.
lines.zh: 不过嘛。

lines.en: I’ve got nothing to lose...remember?
lines.zh: 我已经没什么可失去的了……记得吗？

lines.en: Plus, this is what that voice in the back of my head wants.
lines.zh: 再说，这正是我脑海深处那个声音想要的。

lines.en: If I can keep that at bay, maybe someone else might avoid my wrath next.
lines.zh: 如果我能把它压住，也许下一个人就能躲过我的怒火。

lines.en: Maybe one less girl will find herself being sexually assaulted on the floor of a karaoke booth...
lines.zh: 也许就能少一个女孩在卡拉 OK 包厢的地板上被性侵……

lines.en: Or a dark room in a mansion...
lines.zh: 或者在宅邸的暗房里……

lines.en: Or surrounded by dilapidated buildings in the most evil part of town...
lines.zh: 或者在城里最邪恶的街区、被破败的建筑包围的地方……

lines.en: Maybe there’s someone it’s {i}okay{/i} for me to hurt?
lines.zh: 也许有那么一个人，我伤害她是{i}没关系{/i}的？

lines.en: : A...{i}different{/i} one?
lines.zh: : {i}另一{/i}个……家？

lines.en: Maybe that someone is her?
lines.zh: 也许那个人就是她？
